entry.description: Escape NUL characters and lone surrogates in `AdoNetAppender` text parameters, and cut them to `Size` without splitting a surrogate pair. PostgreSQL rejected such values, which lost the event. A database that can store them now receives `\0` and `\uXXXX` instead (ANT-2026-NIG6OWNC, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
